scope: Ordinary DJ2 inventory and resource conservation with the accepted Core and DJ2Fix, without runtime changes

normal_conversions: 1 minecraft:iron_ore -> 1 minecraft:iron_ingot; 1 minecraft:coal consumed as furnace fuel
accepted_actions: normal left/right clicks, split and merge, hotbar shift return
own single chest, double chest, Iron Chest and wilderness chest round trips
team member and owner transfers without OP
personal Ender Chest storage and withdrawal after restart
native crafting table recipe and furnace smelting
four normal dirt placements, breaks and pickups
reconnect and full server restart with typed named-item NBT preserved
named tool deposit and withdrawal after restart

accepted_reads: snapshot digests and both stopped-world archives
saved Core and Fix versions, survival mode and actual FTB claim boundaries
independent seed and crafting/fuel accounting formula
complete player and personal Ender inventories, container inventories and item entities
all custom marker NBT including tag types; each named stack exactly once
placed blocks returned to air after ordinary pickup

excluded_private_fixture_failures: initial seed arithmetic expected 78 instead of 77
protocol actor originally predicted the source stack for a full QUICK_MOVE; pinned Container returns EMPTY
serialized air placeholder has a nonzero Count; native empty wire slot is the authoritative emptiness check
limits: Server-side protocol actors do not execute client mods or render the inventory GUI
This is a finite set of ordinary actions, not exhaustive inventory, crafting or machine acceptance
ME networks, autocrafting, portable inventory variants, death and interrupted transactions are separate scopes
No live world, VPS, release, calendar or new runtime guard was changed
